title: New coin: 1oz Halier copper
body: Just added support for the 1oz Rand Refinery silver bar (48 × 31 × 3 mm, 0.999 purity). Tap to add it to your stack.

title: Faster catalog updates
body: We dropped the spec sync interval from 24 hours to 1 hour, so new bars and coins now reach you the same day they're added.

title: Welcome to News
body: This is where you'll see new bars, new coins, app features, and updates from the team. Tap the bell on the dashboard any time.
